_about: Degree tables for the auspicious/poison-degree fame experiment. Sign keys 0-indexed (0=Aries..11=Pisces). Navamsa numbers 1-9 (each 3 deg 20 min). Bhaga degrees are within-sign (0-30). Confirmed by Nandish 2026-07-05.

pushkara_navamsa._comment: 0-indexed sign -> list of Pushkara (benefic) navamsa numbers. Element-based.

pushkara_bhaga._comment: 0-indexed sign -> the auspicious degree within the sign (any body within tolerance_deg counts). Confirmed Nandish 2026-07-05.
